Commentary.Commentary: That is all we have today from this game. India need to get the process right for the coming match whereas Zimbabwe will look to seal the series on 20th of June at the same venue at 1630 IST! Until then, take care and goodbye

Man of the Match, ELTON CHIGUMBURA, he says that it was an overall good effort by the team. On the next game, he feels that it is difficult to maintain the momentum but is confident to carry on the same.
GRAEME CREMER, the winning captain, feels that they played well to win today. On the remaining two games, he states that India are a quality side and will look maintain the momentum against them.

MS DHONI says that they all have to do well at the international level as everybody was feeling the pressure because playing in domestic and 'A' Tours are different and playing for India is high pressure always. Also talks about the mistakes made by the batsmen. On their next game, he says they will look to play the basics better.

Overall, the hosts bowled really well as they kept taking wickets at regular intervals. Barring Cremer, others were right on the money. Muzarabani and Chibhabha took 2 wickets each with the latter bowling only 2 overs. Raza too bowled well to concede 18 runs off his 3 overs. At the end, Madziva was the hero to pull off a victory with a terrfic last over. Stay tuned for the presentation..

Axar was dismissed on the second ball of the final over after that,  wonderful cameo. Madziva bowled really well to keep it tight and at the end, Dhoni had to score a four on the last ball. A brilliant last ball eventually served Zimbabwe back-to-back wins against India in T20Is.

India started off poorly as KL Rahul got out off the very first ball for a duck. The duo of Mandeep and Rayudu built a good 44-run stand to steady the ship though but both of them got out in quick succession. Towards the end, Pandey and Dhoni took the game pretty deep with a 53-run stand but Pandey got out on 48 to keep the game in the balance. Towards the death overs, Dhoni and Axar played well to take the game to the final over where only 8 were needed.

What a match we have had! Zimbabwe, take a bow! After asking to bat first, they did well to post that good total.  And credit goes to Chigumbura who scored  54 off 26 balls and took the home side to the 170-mark.
No, is the answer! Full and wide outside off, Dhoni had to reach out for it and at the end, could only manage a single through point. ZIMBABWE BEAT INDIA BY 2 RUNS!
Full outside off, Dhawan slices that through backward point for a single. 4 needed off the last ball, Can Dhoni bring it home?
Wide! Similar ball, that was too close. Dhawan once again comes across and tries to scoop that. Wide is given this time. 5 needed off 2 now. Dhawan, what will he do next?
Sees Dhawan coming across, hurls it wide outside off, Dhawan tries to steer but gets beaten. Wide is not given as he was too across.
Low full toss on off, Dhoni pushes it towards covers for a single.
Rishi Dhawan to bat next.

OUT! No, he doesn't! He is out! Fuller ball outside off, Axar goes for a glory shot but plays it straight to the throat of (Sub)Wellington at long off. Oh dear, once again, the battle of finishing it off has been on the shoulders of Dhoni. Can he amend once again? Game on. Still 7 needed of 4!
Fuller ball on off, Dhoni whacks that through mid off for a single. 7 needed now off last 5! Can Axar finish it off in style?

Fuller on off, driven to covers.

Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Can India escape a defeat or will see Zimababwe get their first win today?
